---
title: "Core genes: pyMLST typing"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B, %Y')`"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
params:
  n_core: null    # minimum number of genomes sharing a core gene
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

# the genome of each index (the pyMLST strains are the indexes of the genomes)
index <- read_tsv("core_genes_index.tsv", col_types = cols(index = "c", genome = "c"))
genome_name <- setNames(index$genome, index$index)

#' Read the distance matrix of `wgMLST distance` (first line: the number of strains, then one row per strain)
#'
#' @param f the distance file
#' @return a numeric matrix, its rows and columns named by the genomes
read_pymlst_distance <- function(f) {
	d <- read_tsv(f, skip = 1, col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(X1 = "c", .default = "d"))
	m <- as.matrix(d[-1])
	dimnames(m) <- list(genome_name[d$X1], genome_name[d$X1])
	m
}

dist_mat <- read_pymlst_distance("pymlst/distance.tsv")
# genomes ordered by a hierarchical clustering of their distances
genome_order <- if (nrow(dist_mat) > 2) {
	rownames(dist_mat)[hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = "average")$order]
} else rownames(dist_mat)
```

`r nrow(dist_mat)` genomes, typed with pyMLST (wgMLST) on their core genes (genes found in at least `r params$n_core` genomes).

# Summary

The genes of the clusters of reciprocal hits (one gene per genome in each cluster), and the core template genes (one
per core cluster: the template of the pyMLST database).

```{r summary}
genes <- read_tsv("core_genes.tsv", col_types = cols(genome = "c", is_core_template = "l", .default = "c"))

tibble(
	Genomes = n_distinct(genes$genome),
	Genes = nrow(genes),
	`Gene clusters` = n_distinct(genes$cluster_id),
	`Core template genes` = sum(genes$is_core_template)
) |>
	knitr::kable(caption = "All the genomes")

genes |>
	group_by(index = genome) |>
	summarise(Genes = n(), `Core template genes` = sum(is_core_template)) |>
	mutate(Genome = genome_name[index]) |>
	arrange(as.integer(index)) |>
	select(Index = index, Genome, Genes, `Core template genes`) |>
	knitr::kable(caption = "Genes of each genome")
```

# Distance matrix

The number of core genes with different alleles in each pair of genomes (genomes ordered by an average linkage clustering).

```{r distance_heatmap, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
as_tibble(dist_mat, rownames = "genome1") |>
	pivot_longer(-genome1, names_to = "genome2", values_to = "distance") |>
	mutate(genome1 = factor(genome1, genome_order), genome2 = factor(genome2, rev(genome_order))) |>
	ggplot(aes(genome1, genome2, fill = distance)) +
	geom_tile(color = "white") +
	geom_text(aes(label = distance), size = 3) +
	scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1) +
	coord_equal() +
	labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Distance") +
	theme_minimal() +
	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# Allele matrix

The allele of each core gene in each genome: in each gene, the alleles are numbered by decreasing frequency
(1: the most frequent allele), white for a gene missing in the genome. Hover a cell for its pyMLST allele id.

```{r allele_heatmap}
alleles <- read_tsv("pymlst/mlst.tsv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
	rename(gene = 1) |>
	pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "index", values_to = "allele") |>
	mutate(genome = genome_name[index]) |>
	group_by(gene) |>
	mutate(rank = match(allele, names(sort(table(allele), decreasing = TRUE)))) |>    # NA for a missing gene
	ungroup()

genes <- unique(alleles$gene)
z <- alleles |>
	mutate(gene = factor(gene, genes), genome = factor(genome, genome_order)) |>
	arrange(genome, gene)
z_mat <- matrix(z$rank, nrow = length(genome_order), byrow = TRUE)
text_mat <- matrix(sprintf("gene: %s<br>genome: %s<br>allele: %s", z$gene, z$genome, replace_na(z$allele, "missing")),
	nrow = length(genome_order), byrow = TRUE)

plot_ly(
	x = genes, y = genome_order, z = z_mat, text = text_mat, hoverinfo = "text",
	type = "heatmap", colorscale = "Viridis", colorbar = list(title = "Allele rank")
) |>
	layout(
		xaxis = list(title = "Core gene", showticklabels = length(genes) <= 100),
		yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed")
	)
```

# Minimum spanning tree

The minimum spanning tree of the genomes for the pyMLST distances (edges labelled by the distance).

```{r mst, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
# a distance of 0 (identical genomes) would be no edge in the adjacency graph: add a tiny weight to all the edges
g0 <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(dist_mat + 1e-9, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
mst_g <- as_tbl_graph(igraph::mst(g0)) |>
	activate(edges) |>
	mutate(distance = round(weight))

ggraph(mst_g, layout = "stress") +
	geom_edge_link(aes(label = distance), angle_calc = "along", label_dodge = unit(2.5, "mm"), color = "grey50") +
	geom_node_point(size = 6, color = "steelblue") +
	geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE) +
	theme_graph(base_family = "sans")
```
